title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems and improve their coding skills.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission and Evaluation
features.description: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Enables users to create profiles to track their progress, solved problems, and rankings.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance.

features.name: Hints and Explanations
features.description: Provides hints and detailed explanations for problems to help users learn effectively.

constraints: Must handle high traffic and concurrent users
Requires a robust code evaluation system
target_users: Students, competitive programmers, and individuals preparing for coding competitions
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, code submissions, and evaluation results
